HUMAN_STEWARD.notes: Records explicit human-directed working state only. Human Steward authority is external and must never be inferred from protocol traffic.

INTELLECT.notes: Coordinates search and may record working obligations and conflict-derived search constraints; it does not manufacture mathematical certification.

MATHFORGE.notes: Exploratory foundry. Blackboard events remain working-state contributions and theory-agent responses remain proposals.

MATHSOLVE.notes: Campaign reasoning plane. May derive and diagnose working mathematical state but cannot certify canonical claims.

MATHCERT.notes: Records certification evidence and checker-backed rejection. Canonical promotion remains governed by existing MATHCERT and claim-ledger procedures.

CHECKER.notes: Machine checker or independently replayable verifier. Result recording is evidence, not direct ledger mutation.

EXTERNAL_TOOL.notes: Untrusted external reasoner or tool. Outputs are proposals or witness artifacts until independently checked.
